ns2:course.label: Mechanics and Relativity II
ns2:course.description: (PHYCS 326) Continuation of PHYS 325. Topics include Lagrangian techniques and the calculus of variations, central force motion, scattering, coupled oscillations, the wave equation in one dimension, generalized coordinates and the Hamiltonian formulation, relativistic dynamics, Euler angles and tops, non-linear and fluid dynamics. Prerequisite: PHYS 325; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 380; or consent of instructor.
